subject: Conditional acceptance criteria & data retention for MAP — ClearBridge
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + conditional acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MPA_v1.docx) that includes the suggested security gate milestones we typically use for financial customers. A few items we want to get aligned on early so your procurement and legal teams can evaluate:

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for Production services. We will provide the latest report and the SOC 2 scope summary (attached). Can you confirm which control families you need evidence for (e.g., CC6, CC7 are commonly requested for data protection/availability)?
- SIG / CAIQ: We've completed the SIG matrix for the baseline offering. There are a handful of outstanding questions around encryption-at-rest key management and customer-managed KMS which I flagged in the SIG-CAIQ_matrix.xlsx.
- DPA & retention: Our standard DPA proposes 12 months of indexed logs and 30 days of request-level telemetry. I note ClearBridge historically asks for longer archives for auditability — can you confirm target retention windows for transaction logs and PII?
- Conditional acceptance / stoplight: To accelerate the pilot we typically define "conditional acceptance" criteria (green/yellow/red) so the team can proceed with a limited production pilot while outstanding items are resolved. I've sketched a suggested stoplight in the MPA.

Next steps: if you can confirm the SOC 2 families and retention targets, we will circulate a refined MPA and flag any DPA carveouts. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with your procurement/legal to walk through the exceptions.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MPA_v1.docx (draft MAP), SOC2-scope-summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ_matrix.xlsx

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@clearbridge.com>, Procurement <procure@clearbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + conditional acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Neha —

Thanks for the package and for the clear framing. A few answers and asks from our side:

- SOC 2 families: we need evidence for CC6 (System and Communications Protection) and CC7 (System and Information Integrity), plus CC3 controls that touch on change management for model deployments.
- SIG: the KMS question is important. Our default requirement is that keys for customer data are customer-managed (BYOK) when dealing with production PII. Is that available in Redwood Private or Dedicated?
- Retention: for transaction logs we need 3 years for regulatory audits; for request-level telemetry (non-PII) 90 days is acceptable. For PII-derived artifacts, we need options to purge/shorten retention on request.
- Conditional acceptance: procurement prefers a 60-day pilot with an agreed remediation plan (yellow items) and a small credit if remediation timelines slip.

Tom (legal) — can you review the attached DPA language and flag high-level objections? Procurement team — want to schedule a call Thursday to align on timelines.

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Senior Security Officer
ClearBridge Bank

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: internal: ClearBridge asks re SOC2 / KMS / retention

Neha — capturing my quick read after Maria's replies:

- SOC 2: CC3 + CC6 + CC7 are reasonable. We can surface the SOC 2 report and a control matrix showing where each control is mapped to a Redwood artifact.
- KMS: BYOK is supported in Redwood Private and Dedicated offering via customer-managed KMS integration. Hosted (multi-tenant) does not support BYOK today; we can offer envelope encryption and provide attestations for our key custody practices. This is a gating item if they require BYOK for prod PII.
- Retention: 3-year transaction log retention is longer than our standard. Options: (a) Dedicated/Private with S3 lifecycle to cold storage (cost + contract addendum), or (b) redact PII at ingestion and keep indexes for 3 years. We'll need legal to weigh in on DPA carveouts.

I'll draft a short stoplight table (green=pilot allowed; yellow=pilot allowed with remediation plan and credit; red=no pilot) that maps to the three asks above. Vivek / Laura — can you vet cost/ops impacts for a 3-year retention path?

- Priyom

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: internal: ClearBridge asks re SOC2 / KMS / retention

Quick operational notes:

- 3-year retention (transaction logs) via Dedicated: feasible but increases storage/ingest costs ~+18% and requires an MPA line-item for cold storage egress. Need to surface that to procurement.
- BYOK for Dedicated/Private: engineering uplift is minimal; we already have KMS connectors for AWS, Azure, GCP. For Private (on-prem) we can accommodate customer HSM/KMS with appropriate testing window in the MAP (typically 3-4 weeks).
- Purge on request for PII-derived artifacts: we can implement delete-on-demand for identifiable artifacts; we should define the SLA for deletions (e.g., 72 hours after request).

I'll annotate the MPA with these options and estimated cost delta.
Vivek

From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@clearbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + conditional acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Neha/Maria —

Looks good at a high level. A few legal redlines already:

1) DPA carveout: we need explicit commit language for deletion timelines (we propose 30 days for non-archival, 72 hours for ad-hoc PII deletions).
2) Retention: we require contractual guarantee that the 3-year archive is immutable for audit purposes; suggest using WORM storage or append-only logs if Redwood manages the archive.
3) SLA/credits: procurement's proposed credit for remediation slippage needs thresholds (e.g., >30 days past agreed remediation window triggers 5% credit for the pilot month).

Please send an updated MPA + DPA markups. I can review the next iteration quickly.

Tom
Legal Counsel
ClearBridge Bank

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearbridge.com>, Tom Blake <tom.blake@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@clearbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + conditional acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Maria / Tom —

Thanks — we'll turn this into a revised MPA with a stoplight table and a short DPA mark-up addressing the deletion timelines, immutability options, and pilot-credit thresholds. Actions we are taking this week:

- Priyom/Vivek to add stoplight table + cost delta for 3-year retention into MPA (ETA: EOD Fri).
- Legal (Redwood) to propose DPA language for delete SLA and immutability options (ETA: Mon).
- Schedule: Proposed pilot start 6/21 for 60 days conditional acceptance; call to align procurement/legal Thu 6/3 at 10am PT (I'll send invite).

If that timeline works for you we'll circulate the updated MPA and DPA markups and aim to lock the pilot terms next week.

Best,
Neha
